exact_statement: For disjoint equal-width tribes f=1-2 product_(j=1)^m(1-AND_w), all w,m>=1, p=2^-w,b=1-p,a=b^m,t=b^(m-1), and bit entropy Phi(A,E)=-(A log2 A)-(E log2 E)+(A+E)log2(A+E), singleton erasure is B_i=4p(1-2p)t+4(t-t^2)Phi(b^2,p^2)+Phi((1-2a)^2,4p^2t^2). With I_i=2pt, 2(1-2p)<=B/I<=2(1-2p)+8pw+(4+4/e)p/ln2 and 4b(1-1/w)<=H/I<=4b+6/(w ln2). Consequently B/I->2,H/I->4,B/H->1/2 uniformly over arbitrary m=m(w)>=1 as w->infinity.
hypotheses: Uniform finite cube; Boolean sign output; m disjoint blocks of common width w; m,w positive integers; entropy in bits; zero logarithm terms interpreted continuously.
